title: Continuous Mirror supermask over a fixed random-feature backbone
hypothesis: For task functions generated by one shared readout under task-indexed Givens views, a quantized scalar Mirror coordinate uses fewer serialized bits than a per-task binary supermask while recovering near-independent held-out quality.
physical_object: fixed deterministic random-feature encoder and one shared output readout
mirror_coordinate: one signed int8 quantized scalar angle per task; shared deterministic frequency schedule
controls: binary per-task supermask with packed bits

task.teacher: 32 task functions share one readout, each transformed by one task angle in a fixed pairwise-Givens orbit

development.selection_reason: At LR .003 Mirror was within 1.1x independent readout in both amended development worlds and complete compact payload was 0.788x packed binary masks; LR .01 included an independent model near-zero point while Mirror remained near 2e-5, so LR .003 was locked based on the relative-quality access gate.

fresh.access_condition: Amended development at LR 0.003: in both worlds Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent and actual Mirror payload <=0.80x packed binary-mask payload.

training.binary_mask_training: straight-through hard threshold; serialize only packed inference bits

storage.serialization: deterministic custom binary payload: uint16 JSON-header length, compact JSON metadata, then little-endian tensor bytes; actual byte length includes header and every inference tensor
paid_objects: all per-task mask bits or gates or angle codes

gates.promising: 3/3 fresh worlds Mirror normalized MSE <=1.10x independent; Mirror payload <=0.80x binary masks and independent; Mirror quality at least 10% better than binary mask and continuous-gate controls at equal/lower bytes.
gates.fail: development access gate misses, or in >=2 fresh worlds binary/continuous control matches within 10% at equal/lower bytes, or Mirror misses independent quality by >25%.
gates.not_established: invalid split, serialization mismatch, or incomplete runs

boundaries: no learned task inference or continual stream
fixed-update screen is not capacity evidence

amendments.reason: The initial four-task torch.save ZIP archive had equal 2,149-byte Mirror and packed-mask payloads due container alignment/metadata overhead, failing the predeclared storage access gate. To test storage per logical task rather than archive padding, task count was increased to 32 and the full payload switched to deterministic compact binary serialization. The pre-amendment results remain preserved separately and are excluded from the amended screen.
